title: Paris Anniversary

pois.name: Musée d'Orsay
pois.description: Housed in a stunning former railway station, this museum holds the world's largest collection of Impressionist masterpieces.
pois.why_picked: As a bucket list trip for art lovers, this is an architectural marvel and an essential cultural experience.
pois.experience: You will wander through the light-filled nave to see works by Monet and Van Gogh, then visit the giant clock window for a panoramic view of the Seine.

pois.name: Le Potager de Charlotte
pois.description: A sophisticated plant-based restaurant known for its creative, seasonal, and gourmet approach to vegetables.
pois.why_picked: You requested Michelin-quality plant-based dining; this is widely considered one of the best vegan culinary experiences in Paris.
pois.experience: Enjoy a refined, multi-course dinner in an intimate setting that focuses on the purity of plant ingredients.

pois.name: Sainte-Chapelle
pois.description: A 13th-century royal chapel featuring the most exquisite collection of stained glass in the world.
pois.why_picked: The architecture here is profoundly meaningful and awe-inspiring, perfect for a special anniversary visit.
pois.experience: Step inside to see the light filter through 1,113 stained glass windows; it creates a spiritual and deeply moving atmosphere.

pois.name: Le Caveau de la Huchette
pois.description: A legendary underground jazz cellar located in a medieval building.
pois.why_picked: It offers a unique, quintessential Parisian nightlife experience that is soulful and historic rather than just flashy.
pois.experience: Descend into the limestone caves for high-energy live jazz; it is an iconic, intimate spot that feels frozen in time.

pois.name: Les Caves du Louvre
pois.description: A historic wine cellar once used by the King of France, now dedicated to wine education and tasting.
pois.why_picked: You mentioned a love for vineyards and bold reds; this provides an expert-led tasting in a space steeped in history.
pois.experience: You will explore the sensory profiles of French wines, specifically focusing on full-bodied reds from Bordeaux and the Rhône Valley.

pois.name: Arpège
pois.description: Chef Alain Passard’s legendary restaurant where vegetables are the stars of the show.
pois.why_picked: This is the ultimate bucket list experience for a plant-focused fine dining enthusiast, holding three Michelin stars for decades.
pois.experience: Expect a highly personalized, artistic meal where the menu is dictated by what is harvested from the chef's own farms that morning.

pois.name: Private Seine River Sunset Cruise
pois.description: A private boat tour along the Seine to view the city's architecture as the sun sets.
pois.why_picked: A private cruise is a special, intimate way to celebrate an anniversary while seeing the major monuments without the crowds.
pois.experience: You will have a quiet moment on the water to watch the Eiffel Tower begin to sparkle, providing a meaningful backdrop for your trip.

pois.name: Musée de l'Orangerie
pois.description: An art gallery of impressionist and post-impressionist paintings, most famous for housing Monet's large Water Lilies murals.
pois.why_picked: The immersive nature of the Water Lilies room is serene and meditative, perfect for a meaningful, low-stress artistic experience.
pois.experience: Sit on the center benches in the oval rooms and take in the massive, peaceful murals that wrap around you.

pois.name: Jardin du Luxembourg
pois.description: A stunning, quintessential Parisian park filled with statues, fountains, and manicured pathways.
pois.why_picked: It is a beautiful, peaceful place to rest and enjoy the architecture of the city at a leisurely pace.
pois.experience: Grab a coffee and sit on the iconic green metal chairs by the Medici Fountain for a quintessential Parisian afternoon.

pois.name: Palais Garnier
pois.description: A 19th-century opera house known for its opulent architecture and Chagall-painted ceiling.
pois.why_picked: This is one of the most beautiful buildings in the world and provides a sense of grandeur that feels truly special for an anniversary.
pois.experience: Take a self-guided tour of the Grand Staircase and the lavish auditorium to see the level of craftsmanship that defines Paris.

pois.name: Le Marais District
pois.description: A historic district known for narrow medieval streets, hidden courtyards, and boutique galleries.
pois.why_picked: It is the heart of old Paris and offers a charming, authentic atmosphere for wandering together.
pois.experience: Explore the Place des Vosges, the oldest planned square in Paris, and stop at independent art galleries and quiet cafes.

pois.name: Fondation Louis Vuitton
pois.description: A contemporary art museum and cultural center housed in a spectacular building designed by Frank Gehry.
pois.why_picked: The architecture is bold and unique, offering a modern contrast to the classic sights of the city.
pois.experience: Walk through the glass sails of the building and enjoy world-class rotating exhibitions in a spacious, airy environment.

pois.name: Château de Versailles Gardens
pois.description: Explore the breathtaking royal gardens designed by André Le Nôtre, offering immense beauty and tranquility.
pois.why_picked: Since you love the artistic grandeur of the Musée d'Orsay and the Palais Garnier, the scale and beauty of Versailles are essential for a bucket list trip.
pois.experience: Walk through the manicured groves and fountains. For someone with health considerations, renting a golf cart or using the Petit Train is a wonderful way to enjoy the vast grounds comfortably.

pois.name: Claude Monet's House and Gardens in Giverny
pois.description: Visit the world-famous home and water gardens that inspired Monet's iconic 'Water Lilies' series.
pois.why_picked: This perfectly complements your interest in the Musée de l'Orangerie, allowing you to see the real-life inspiration behind the masterpieces.
pois.experience: Walk across the famous Japanese bridge and admire the vibrant flower beds. It is incredibly peaceful and visually stunning, perfect for a gentle, romantic outing.

pois.name: Abbaye de Royaumont
pois.description: A stunning 13th-century Cistercian abbey surrounded by beautiful gardens and canals, located north of Paris.
pois.why_picked: Since you enjoy the historical and spiritual atmosphere of Sainte-Chapelle, this site offers a similar sense of awe in a quiet, countryside setting.
pois.experience: Stroll through the cloister and the medieval kitchen gardens. The site is serene and less crowded than central Paris, perfect for meaningful anniversary moments.

pois.name: Auvers-sur-Oise Village
pois.location: Auvers Sur Oise-Straat, 4881 DG Zundert, Netherlands
pois.description: The picturesque village where Vincent van Gogh spent his final days, preserved in time with landscapes that look like his paintings.
pois.why_picked: Matches your appreciation for art history and provides a romantic, slow-paced countryside experience.
pois.experience: Walk the path to the fields and visit the Auberge Ravoux. It is a deeply moving and beautiful village that feels like stepping into a canvas.

pois.name: Château de Chantilly
pois.description: A magnificent French chateau housing one of the finest art museums in France and sprawling parklands.
pois.why_picked: It offers the high-end cultural experience of the Palais Garnier but with the expansive nature of a countryside estate.
pois.experience: View the Condé Museum’s impressive art collection and enjoy a slice of the famous Chantilly cream in the park-side cafe.

pois.name: L'Auberge du Jeu de Paume
pois.description: A luxurious restaurant in Chantilly offering refined French cuisine in an elegant, countryside-mansion setting.
pois.why_picked: Since you enjoyed Arpège, this provides a similarly high-end, intimate anniversary dining experience outside the city center.
pois.experience: Expect impeccable service and seasonal dishes. It is a quiet, sophisticated venue perfect for an anniversary celebration.

notes: This is both an anniversary trip and a bucket list item for my wife who has cancer.
